name: The Reaper, King No More
description: A deadly scarecrow contraption, ruler of scarecrows of Shadowmoor, who has lost much of its domain.

timeline.summary: The Reaper loses much of its domain over the scarecrows as the aspects merge.
timeline.quote: But with the planar merging of aspects, it lost much of its domain and control over the scarecrows of Shadowmoor.
